enforcement.readyWhen: The Tax manifest and capability validate, authority is active, all seeds resolve against the pinned UBP revision, and engine-sovereignty-e2e returns READY for the same revision. This requires published executable policy, unique resolution, integrity verification, immutable tenant pinning, explicit upgrade, no runtime country fallback, two real country configurations, a fictitious country and a balanced accounting handoff.
